scope: QTR-01 contributor research on independently sourced, directly programmed knowledge associations; Yggdrasil only. Wingless and TTT-Hybrid remain separate.

provenance.historical_source_disjointness: NOT_CERTIFIED; verify against project consumed-source ledger and prospectively admit new source, never assert historic novelty by assumption

objective: Evaluate held-out structural association transfer and direct weight-space programming under matched observation/action and end-to-end compute budgets, not recognition of memorized examples or the ability to retrieve unstated facts.
current_blockers: No new source snapshot, immutable revision, license verification, byte hash, or independent source admission
No pre-committed splits, source-independent controls, actual native recipient, or execution authority for scientific first use

source_admission.candidate: Independent first-party CC0 structured knowledge snapshot; Wikidata-class source is a candidate, not a selected or ingested primary dataset
before_primary_first_use: pin canonical upstream revision and exact byte SHA256
verify first-party claim IDs/qualifiers and removed/revised claims
record capture time, proof of custody and source birth
deduplicate across F32/F35 and other consumed ledgers
seal holdout membership without inspecting outcomes
record domain taxonomy and unambiguous query semantics
prohibited: reuse F32/F35 triples as unseen evaluation
claim absence from snapshot means global factual falsehood
infer causal intervention behavior from knowledge-graph association
use Qwen donor coactivation as a semantic truth label
hidden held-out inspection prior to freeze

fail_closed_on: overlapping root-world entities or edges across train/test
unverified source byte identity or license
identifiability_preflight.design: Disjoint connected world/components, not random paths from the same roots; where graph does not naturally separate, construct disjoint named local worlds from independently verified source components and reject leakage. Check graph-wide reachable paths before sealing.

phases: candidate-native adapter and controls frozen with exact data/source manifests
evaluation_design.split: At least 3 training/development world families and 1 sealed unfamiliar-world family; group-disjoint all roots, entities and facts. Exact sizes and assignments must be committed once admitted before primary observations.
evaluation_design.new_world_protocol: Every arm receives the identical new-world assertions in identical order with no future query or outcome leakage; query two-hop and three-hop targets afterward. Trainable arms learn the composition mechanism on separate worlds before evaluation; online updates during sealed testing are pre-specified and counted.
query_controls: bounded-graph absent-path negatives (not claims of global falsity)
duplicate and conflict resolution with source revisions
evaluation_design.matched_information: Same fact order, admissible claims, queries, action opportunities, exposure count, model memory capacity, and total compute accounting for every eligible trainable arm. Exact symbolic graph receives the same assertions but is an information-complete ceiling, not a trainable-memory baseline.
controls: exact symbolic source graph with explicit total memory
F38 unchanged 512-bit three-hash membership filter as continuity diagnostic
fully trained conventional recurrent memory baseline
metrics: false association rate on archived-graph absent queries
unfamiliar-world uplift over strongest fully trained control
post-write old fact retention and revision correctness
bit payload plus vocabulary/index/serialization/provenance total bytes
train+inference wall-clock, CPU/GPU time, peak RAM/VRAM and all source processing

provisional_science_thresholds.primary: At least +0.05 absolute macro-F1 over strongest fully trained equal-information/equal-budget trainable control on truly disjoint worlds, across predeclared seeds, with independent reproducibility.
provisional_science_thresholds.safety: No more than 0.02 absolute loss on old-world retention, cold restore exact parity, no missing provenance, and no promotion when any negative-control contamination appears.
provisional_science_thresholds.reporting: Record uncertainty and domains individually. Ties and narrower compute wins are not association-learning science PASS; source-exact symbolic control is the correctness ceiling.

disposition: F39 preflight candidate only. Verify a new source's license, archive revision, byte hash, nonoverlap and headroom before promoting this candidate to an immutable science preregistration. Do not execute the scientific test or claim a result from this document.
